app.name: Uptime
app.description: A minimal, self-hosted uptime monitor with editable dashboards.

iconPicker.label: Icon
iconPicker.title: Choose an icon
iconPicker.usedEmpty: Icons appear here after saving a group, monitor or dashboard.
iconPicker.usedError: Could not load currently used icons.
iconPicker.hint: Search by the library's English icon name or a brand name.

auth.signInDescription: Sign in to edit monitors and dashboards. All views remain public.

monitor.title: Monitors
monitor.downCount: no monitors down | 1 monitor down | {count} monitors down

empty.title: No monitors yet
empty.description: Add the first monitor to start collecting uptime data.
empty.readonly: The admin has not added any monitors yet.

type.httpDescription: Requests a URL and checks the status code, an optional keyword and the TLS certificate.
type.pingDescription: Sends ICMP echo requests to a host and measures the round trip time.

fields.name: Name
fields.keywordInverted: Fail when the keyword is present
fields.certificateExpiryWarningDays: Warn this many days before expiry

hints.expectedStatusCodes: Single codes and ranges, separated by commas. For example 200-299,301.
hints.keyword: The response body must contain this text for the check to pass.
hints.retries: Failures tolerated before the monitor is reported as down.
hints.timeout: Seconds a single check may take.
hints.ignoreTls: Accepts self signed and expired certificates. Only use this for internal hosts.
hints.active: Paused monitors keep their history but are not checked.
hints.group: Groups organise the sidebar tree and the monitor list.
hints.template: Copies every setting of an existing monitor into this form. Only the name is left untouched.

delete.title: Delete monitor
delete.description: "{name}" and its entire history will be removed. Widgets referencing it are deleted as well. This cannot be undone.

detail.avgResponseTimeWithSpread: Average response time with min–max spread

group.title: Groups
group.formDescription: Groups can be nested. A monitor belongs to at most one of them.

hints.parent: Nest this group below another one, or leave it at the top level.

delete.title: Delete group
delete.description: "{name}" will be removed. Its subgroups and monitors are kept and move up to the parent group.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Checks keep running inside a window, but a failure is not reported as an outage and does not count against the uptime.
maintenance.noWindows: No maintenance windows yet. Checks are judged around the clock.
maintenance.timeZoneDescription: Every maintenance window is read against this clock, so a window at 03:00 stays at 03:00 across a daylight saving change.
maintenance.deleteWindowHint: The monitors it covers are judged around the clock again from now on.
maintenance.targetHint: A group covers every monitor below it. Windows add up, so a monitor can be covered by more than one.
maintenance.targetPlaceholder: Choose a monitor or a group
maintenance.covers: covers no monitors | covers 1 monitor | covers {count} monitors
maintenance.noteHint: Optional. A window is recognised by its rhythm, its time and what it covers.
maintenance.notePlaceholder: e.g. Reboots after the nightly backup
maintenance.enabledHint: Switch off to keep the window without it taking effect.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.editModeHint: Drag widgets to reorder; use the arrows to resize. The layout saves automatically.

hints.slug: Used in the address bar, for example /d/production.
hints.isDefault: Visitors landing on the start page are sent to this dashboard.

empty.title: This dashboard is empty
empty.description: Switch to edit mode and add your first widget.
empty.readonly: The admin has not added any widgets to this dashboard yet.

delete.title: Delete dashboard
delete.description: "{name}" and all of its widgets will be removed. The monitors themselves stay untouched.

dashboard.lastDashboard: The last dashboard cannot be deleted.

widget.monitorMissing: The referenced monitor no longer exists.

typeDescription.monitor: Status, response time and the recent pulse of one monitor.
typeDescription.uptime-summary: A single large uptime percentage for one monitor.
typeDescription.latency-chart: Response time over a selectable time range.
typeDescription.uptime-calendar: One square per day, coloured by that day’s uptime.
typeDescription.status-overview: Counts of all monitors by status.
typeDescription.monitor-list: Status, uptime and response time of many monitors in one tile.
typeDescription.incident-feed: Everything that is failing right now, longest running first.
typeDescription.certificate-expiry: TLS certificates ordered by how soon they expire.
typeDescription.sla-table: Uptime against a target, with the error budget left.
typeDescription.incident-history: Outages reconstructed from the check history.
typeDescription.reliability-kpis: Outage count, downtime, MTTR and MTBF over a range.
typeDescription.maintenance-schedule: What is in maintenance now, and which window opens next.
typeDescription.heading: A text label to group widgets.
typeDescription.monitor-repeat: A row of widgets, drawn once for every monitor in a group.

scope.groupHint: A group covers everything below it and follows the tree.

repeat.noChildren: No widgets in this block yet.
repeat.childrenHint: Every monitor in the scope gets this row of widgets, in this order.
repeat.groupHint: A group covers everything below it, and a new monitor joins on its own.
repeat.previewHint: One band with its real data. The dashboard draws it once per monitor.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: The widget with its real data, at the selected size.
preview.selectMonitor: Pick a monitor to see the preview.

maintenance.activeCount: nothing in maintenance | 1 in maintenance | {count} in maintenance

down.subject: [Down] {monitor}
down.title: {monitor} is down
down.summary: The check failed and the monitor has been reported as down.
down.label: Outage

certificate.subject: [Certificate] {monitor}
certificate.title: The certificate for {monitor} expires soon
certificate.summary: The TLS certificate is inside its warning window and needs renewing.
certificate.label: Certificate expiring

test.message: This is a test message from {app}. No monitor is affected.
test.failed: The test message could not be delivered

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where notifications are delivered. Credentials never leave the server.
channels.formDescription: One transport with its own credentials and language.
channels.empty: No channels yet. Add one to start delivering notifications.
channels.deleteMessage: “{name}” is removed from every notification group and stops delivering. Its delivery history is deleted with it.

groups.title: Notification groups
groups.description: A group bundles channels with the events they react to. Monitors are assigned to groups, not to channels.
groups.formDescription: Pick the channels and the events this group reacts to.
groups.empty: No groups yet. A group is what a monitor gets assigned to.
groups.deleteMessage: Monitors assigned to “{name}” stop notifying. The channels themselves are kept.
groups.defaultHint: Applies to monitors that inherit all the way to the root without a decision.
groups.enabledHint: A disabled group delivers nothing, whatever is assigned to it.
groups.noChannels: No channels — this group delivers nothing.
groups.noEvents: No events — this group delivers nothing.

form.name: Name
form.languageHint: Messages are written on the server, so the language is fixed per channel.
form.enabledHint: A disabled channel is skipped without being removed.
form.channelsHint: A channel named by two matching groups still receives one message.
form.eventsHint: Which state changes this group reacts to.

smtp.title: SMTP server
smtp.secureHint: On for port 465. Off uses STARTTLS when the server offers it.
smtp.rejectUnauthorizedHint: Turn off only for a server with a self-signed certificate.
smtp.timezoneHint: Timestamps are rendered once, so an email cannot resolve them per reader.

teams.title: Microsoft Teams
teams.workflowUrlHint: The webhook URL is the permission to post, so it is stored like a password.
teams.setupDescription: In Teams, open the channel menu, choose Workflows and start from the "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" template. For a message, open the flow afterwards, replace "Post card in a chat or channel" with "Post message in a chat or channel" and set its Message to the trigger body's text field. Office 365 connector URLs are retired and are not accepted.
teams.formatDescription: Must match the action used by your workflow.

formatHint.card: Uses "Post card in a chat or channel". Teams shows no preview text for it — the channel list and the activity feed read "Card".
formatHint.message: Uses "Post message in a chat or channel". A compact, robust message with a useful preview on every client.

teams.timezoneHint: A message carries a time rendered once. A card leaves it to Teams, which resolves it for each reader.

assignment.label: Notifications
assignment.noneSelected: Nothing selected, so nothing is delivered.
assignment.inheritsNothing: Nothing is inherited, so nothing is delivered.

modeHint.inherit: Takes whatever the group above decides.
modeHint.custom: Uses the groups selected here and stops the inheritance.
modeHint.muted: Delivers nothing, whatever the group above says.

delivery.title: Deliveries
delivery.description: The last messages the queue handled, newest first.

settings.newPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep it; use at least 10 characters.
settings.monitorPathHint: How much of the group path a monitor is named with.
settings.latencyStyleHint: How every response time chart draws its readings.

data.title: Data
data.description: Manage demo data or delete all data.

clear.label: Delete all data
clear.hint: Deletes monitors, groups, dashboards, and history. The account and settings remain.
clear.title: Delete all data?
clear.description: Every monitor, group, dashboard and heartbeat is removed permanently. This cannot be undone.

demo.label: Reset demo data
demo.hint: Replaces all data with demo dashboards, groups, monitors, and history.
demo.title: Replace everything with demo data?
demo.description: The existing data is deleted first. The demo monitors point at real public endpoints and are checked as soon as they exist.
demo.done: Created {dashboards} dashboards and {monitors} demo monitors in {groups} groups with {days} days of history.

error.dashboardUnavailable: The dashboard could not be loaded. Please try again.
error.monitorUnavailable: The monitor could not be loaded. Please try again.
error.unauthorized: Please sign in as admin to do that.

validation.teamsLegacyConnector: This is an Office 365 connector URL. Create a Teams workflow from the "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received" template and use its URL instead.

validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only
validation.statusCodes: Use single codes or ranges, for example 200-299,301
validation.timeoutTooLong: The timeout must not exceed the check interval
validation.monitorRequired: Select a monitor for this widget
validation.maintenanceTarget: Choose a monitor or a group for this window
validation.repeatChildrenRequired: Add at least one widget to repeat
